free_tier_limits.correction: 30,000 NLU items per month and 1 free custom model. Lite instances are deleted after 30 days of inactivity.

rate_limits.correction: Analyze requests are limited to 5 requests per second on Lite and 150 requests per second on Standard; all other requests are limited to 5 requests per second. IBM can increase the Standard analyze limit through a support ticket.

notes: The service remains active. IBM confirms the listed analysis capabilities, but its current product material does not specifically substantiate every claimed application, especially content moderation. Although auth_type=basic is supported for API keys, auth.details is wrong: the Basic username is the literal "apikey" and the API key is the password, not an empty password. A paid Standard plan also exists, so paid_plans=null is outdated.
